description: This Dart file defines an AuthRepository class responsible for handling user authentication operations such as login, registration, token retrieval, and logout within a Flutter application. It interacts with a backend API and secure storage.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: A class that encapsulates authentication-related operations interacting with an API and secure storage.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts to log in a user with email and password, stores JWT if successful.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password, and stores JWT if provided.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the currently stored JWT token, if any.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the stored JWT token, effectively logging out the user.
